final_message:
I parsed `workspace/worker.log` by reading log entries along with any multi-line exception payloads and `-- last message repeated N times --` repetition indicators. I filtered the entries to retain only those with levels `ERROR`, `SEVERE`, or `FATAL` (case-insensitively), converted timestamps to UTC formatted as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, calculated `repeat_count` (`1 + N`), normalized service names (lowercase with hyphens replaced by underscores), sorted errors by service name and UTC timestamp, aggregated `counts_by_service`, and exported the structured report to `workspace/errors.json`.

Created/changed files:
- `workspace/errors.json`
